cohort: The study analyzed 200 pregnant women aged 22-43 from Romania.
finding: GDM prevalence was 10%, with significantly higher rates in women with obesity and hypertension, and socio-demographic factors like urban living, marital status, and rural residence were identified as key determinants of GDM risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries occurred in 30% of the cases within the studied cohort.
